items.title: PHP 8.6: Things are gonna get a lot more strict around here
items.summary: Like a parent disciplining a misbehaving child, PHP’s annual update clamps down on loose default behaviors to curb malicious hacker horseplay.

items.title: Visa, Mastercard theft included info useful for phishing, but not draining bank accounts, say researchers
items.summary: No financial details, but plenty of other clues

items.title: Signal slams door on prying AI agents to protect privacy
items.summary: Apple, Google, and Microsoft called out for failing to provide developers with adequate AI agent controls

items.title: White House removes cyber-security chief after series of tech outages
items.summary: He has been fired after losing the confidence of new White House chief of staff Stephen Miller, according to reports.

items.title: n0n extortion gang leaks data of JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard customers
items.summary: Data belonging to customers of three of the biggest companies in global finance has been leaked online, after hackers breached third-party service providers working for JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard. Read more in my article on the Hot for Security blog.
